title: Pirates
story: Hoist the sails and hunt for gold on the sunny seas.

cards.name: Treasure Chest
cards.subject: A wooden treasure chest with a curved lid opened wide, iron corner bands and a gold lock plate, filled to the brim with gold coins.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, dark iron grey bands, gold coins, small red gem on top of the coin pile

cards.name: Parrot
cards.subject: A scarlet macaw flying with both wings spread wide, long tail feathers trailing behind, a curved beak and a white face patch.
cards.hero_colors: bright red, white face patch, yellow stripe on wings

cards.name: Ship's Wheel
cards.subject: A wooden ship's wheel with a perfectly round rim, eight evenly spaced spokes that extend past the rim as handles, and a brass hub, mounted on a sturdy wooden helm post fixed to the ship deck.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, brass gold hub
cards.surface_or_setting: a wooden ship deck beside the mast

cards.name: Pirate Hat
cards.subject: A black three-cornered tricorn hat with a wide upturned brim folded up in three symmetrical points and a gold braid along the edge.
cards.hero_colors: black, gold braid trim

cards.name: Pirate Boots
cards.subject: A pair of tall brown leather boots standing side by side, each with a wide folded-over cuff at the top and a gold buckle on the front of the cuff.
cards.hero_colors: leather brown, gold buckles

cards.name: Treasure Map
cards.subject: A flat sheet of aged parchment seen from above with torn edges, a dotted trail winding across it, a simple palm tree icon and a big X icon at the end of the trail.

cards.name: Pirate Ship

cards.name: Spyglass
